title: A Safety-First Gateway Architecture for Trusted Public Health Resource Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2607.13038v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conversational AI can improve access to public health information, but public-facing healthcare applications require safeguards against inappropriate medical guidance and unsupported generation. We present a Safety-First Science Gateway for maternal and child health (MCH) resource navigation that combines large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a multi-layer safety architecture. The gateway integrates emergency handling, domain/scope screening, source attribution, anonymous session management, and operational audit logging while restricting retrieval to curated institutional resources. We describe the gateway architecture, prototype implementation, and functional verification of selected workflows. The current system provides resource provenance and safety-bounded navigation; it does not constitute a clinical decision-support system or automated claim-by-claim verification of generated health

translated_title: 一种用于可信公共卫生资源导航的安全优先网关架构
translated_abstract: 对话式人工智能能够改善公共卫生信息的获取，但面向公众的医疗保健应用需要防范不当的医疗指导和缺乏依据的内容生成。我们提出了一种面向妇幼保健（MCH）资源导航的安全优先科学网关，该网关将大语言模型（LLM）与检索增强生成（RAG）相结合，并采用多层安全架构。该网关集成了紧急情况处理、领域/范围筛查、来源归属标注、匿名会话管理和运行审计日志等功能，同时将检索范围限制在经过审核的机构资源内。我们描述了该网关的架构、原型实现以及所选工作流程的功能验证。当前系统提供资源溯源和安全受限的导航功能；它并不构成临床决策支持系统，也不提供对生成的健康内容的逐条自动化验证。
tldr: 提出了一种将大语言模型与检索增强生成相结合的多层安全架构网关，通过紧急处理、范围筛查、来源归属和审计日志等机制，实现面向妇幼保健领域的可信且安全受限的公共卫生资源导航。
en_tdlr: A safety-first gateway architecture combining LLMs and RAG with multi-layer safeguards—including emergency handling, scope screening, source attribution, and audit logging—enables trusted, safety-bounded navigation of maternal and child health resources.
